en.headline: Government outlines seven reform areas after Wang Fuk fire report
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee announced comprehensive changes covering bid-rigging, regulation and complaint handling following the independent committee's findings on the Tai Po tragedy.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Thursday that the government would roll out comprehensive reforms covering seven areas to address shortcomings exposed by the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po that killed 168 people last November.

The reforms include establishing specific criminal offences for bid-rigging in building maintenance projects and incorporating them into the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance, amending the law so the Competition Commission can use both criminal and civil measures, and forming an inter-departmental task force with police and the ICAC.

An authority will be set up to give homeowners independent professional advice on maintenance, taking over services from the Urban Renewal Authority. The Buildings Department will be restructured, a centralised database of past convictions and misconduct will be created, and the complaint mechanism will be integrated with artificial intelligence monitoring.

A steering committee chaired by Chief Secretary Eric Chan will oversee implementation of the independent committee's 120 recommendations. The committee found that the main contractor Prestige Construction and Engineering, consultant Will Power Architects and a registered inspector bore the most significant accountability, while several government departments including the Housing Bureau's Independent Checking Unit shared responsibility for regulatory failures.

zh.headline: 政府公布宏福苑火災報告後七大改革方向
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超宣布全面改革，涵蓋圍標、監管及投訴機制，回應獨立委員會對大埔悲劇的調查結果。
body: 行政長官李家超周四表示，政府將推行涵蓋七個範疇的全面改革，以應對去年11月大埔宏福苑火災暴露的不足之處。該火災造成168人死亡。
改革包括就大廈維修工程的圍標行為訂立具體刑事罪行，並納入《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》；修訂法例讓競爭事務委員會可同時以刑事及民事方式打擊圍標；並與警方及廉政公署成立跨部門專責小組。
政府將成立新機構，為業主提供獨立專業的維修建議，接管目前由市區重建局提供的相關服務。屋宇署將重組以加強領導及監督，並設立中央資料庫記錄過往定罪及專業失當，投訴機制亦會整合並引入人工智能監察。
由政務司司長陳國基擔任主席的督導委員會將確保獨立委員會提出的120項建議得到全面有效落實。委員會認為主承建商Prestige Construction及顧問公司Will Power Architects連同註冊檢驗人須承擔最重大責任，而包括房屋局獨立審查組在內的多個政府部門亦須分擔監管失職的責任。
